physicalEvidence.status: Verified real learned robot at prior host; Berkeley hardware access unverified
physicalEvidence.summary: Full September 21, 2026 revision of Observing and Controlling Features in Vision-Language-Action Models verifies frozen pi0.5 with trained linear observers and representation interventions on real DROID hardware. Three hardware tasks use 50 rollouts per method: coffee-mug handle preference and choosing appropriate objects for a blender/oven. Object selection/manipulation is evaluated; full cooking tasks are not. The observer-output constraint is guaranteed within the model, but physical safety is not. LIBERO trials and DROID/BridgeData probing are separately simulated/dataset experiments. Authors are Stanford-affiliated in this study; no Berkeley platform or visitor access has been established. Physical20 for attributable prior-host collaborative execution.
